slots.product: Emamectin Benzoate 1.25% + Lambda Cyhalothrin 1.5% + Bifenthrin 4.5% EC

items.message: The CIB&RC register lists Emamectin Benzoate 1.25% + Lambda Cyhalothrin 1.5% + Bifenthrin 4.5% EC as approved for stem borer and leaf folder in Paddy ( Rice) at a dose_form of 750 ml per hectare, dilution of 500 litres per hectare, and a waiting period of 17 days.
items.headline: Approved: Emamectin Benzoate 1.25% + Lambda Cyhalothrin 1.5% + Bifenthrin 4.5% EC on Paddy ( Rice) for leaf folder is listed in the register (p. 70).

items.headline: Approved: Copper Sulphate 47.15% + Mancozeb 30% WDG on Pomegranate for bacterial blight is listed in the register (p. 59).

items.message: The CIB&RC register does not list Difenoconazole 10% + Mancozeb 50% WDG for use against scab on apple. Other products are registered for this use, such as Captan 50% WP, Captan 75% WP, Carbendazim 50%WP, Chlorothalonil 75% WP, and Difenoconazole 25% EC.
items.headline: Not listed for this pest: Difenoconazole 10% + Mancozeb 50% WDG is registered on apple, but not for scab.

items.message: Mancozeb 75% WG is approved for late blight in potato, but it is not approved for early blight. Mancozeb is banned for use on Guava, Jowar and Tapioca.
items.headline: More than one match; please choose one of the options.
